svg.title: CDN
svg.desc: The origin sits in Virginia, with edge servers in Tokyo and London. The first Tokyo viewer misses, so the Tokyo edge fetches logo.png from Virginia, keeps a copy, and the answer takes 160 ms. Every Tokyo viewer after that gets the local copy in a few milliseconds. London does the same, and the origin only ever sees two requests.
svg.text: The first viewer fills the nearby edge. Everyone after gets it in a few ms.
